evidence.title: Trigger.dev | The open source platform for durable AI agents

name: Trigger.dev
summary: Open-source TypeScript platform for durable AI agents and background tasks: no timeouts, retries, queues and realtime streaming.
description: Runs AI agents and long-running workflows as plain async TypeScript functions with no workflow DSL, deployed with one command. CRIU checkpoint-resume snapshots keep tasks alive for hours or days — paused runs use no compute and are not billed — while retries, queues and concurrency, scheduled tasks, waitpoints for human-in-the-loop approvals, realtime LLM token streaming to React hooks and OpenTelemetry observability are built in. Apache-2.0; self-host on Docker Compose or Kubernetes, or use Trigger.dev Cloud.
contains: tasks are plain async TypeScript functions; no workflow DSL or determinism rules
checkpoint-resume snapshots (CRIU) resume tasks where they stopped; paused runs cost nothing
no timeouts: runs last hours, days or weeks
built-ins: retries, queues and concurrency, schedules, waitpoints, realtime streams, LLM observability
self-host with Docker Compose or Kubernetes; Apache 2.0, same codebase as Cloud
SDKs and build extensions: TypeScript, React hooks, MCP server, Python, Prisma, FFmpeg, Playwright
cloud plans: Free $0, Hobby $10, Pro $50, Enterprise custom
